Find where step A's hand work ends and step B's begins. first_ends_s: the label of the last frame in which the hands are still doing step A (holding the tool at step A's place or part, or finishing its action). second_begins_s: the label of the first frame in which the hands are at step B's place or part, or start its action. Moving between places, putting a tool down or picking one up belongs to neither step. Be strict: a frame that might still be step A counts as step A. Answer only from the frames; use -1 when no frame shows the step.
